body.description: 1 to 10,000 characters, not blank, stored as sent

internal.description: An internal note, visible to support staff only; false when absent

openTicket.description: The ticket open on the user's page when they asked, which "this ticket" in the question means; absent on any other page

arguments.description: The arguments as the model wrote them

resolution.description: At most 2,000 characters; replaces the stored resolution, while a blank or absent one keeps it

description.description: At most 10,000 characters, stored as sent; empty when absent

waitingForCustomer.description: The organization's tickets waiting for customer: support staff await an answer

type.description: RELATED or POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE; a potential duplicate is stored from the later ticket to the earlier one, whichever ticket the request addresses

apiVersion.description: Version of this server build (the Maven project version).

service.description: Always retrofit: lets a client tell this service from a captive portal or proxy page answering the same path.

items.description: User role. USER is a customer, SUPPORT is support staff.

member.description: true when this is the signed-in user's team

members.description: The team's enabled support staff, sorted by name ignoring case

assignedToMe.description: Tickets assigned to the signed-in support member

dueWithinHour.description: Tickets still awaiting a first response, not closed, whose response deadline falls within the next hour

myTeam.description: Tickets of the signed-in support member's team

pastDeadline.description: Tickets still awaiting a first response, not closed, past their response deadline

unansweredCustomerComment.description: Tickets with an unanswered customer comment: the latest public comment, by a customer, on a ticket in progress after its first response

unassigned.description: Tickets neither resolved nor closed without an assignee

version.description: Rises with every change; sent as the `ETag`

unansweredCustomerCommentAt.description: When the unanswered customer comment was written: the latest public comment, by a customer, on a ticket in progress after its first response, so support staff owe the next public comment; null when there is none

assigneeId.description: An enabled support member of the resulting team; null unassigns

category.description: BUG, QUESTION or FEATURE_REQUEST; null clears it

description.description: At most 10,000 characters, stored as sent and may be empty; sent alone or with title, never with the other fields; null is refused

resolution.description: At most 2,000 characters; sent only with a resulting status of RESOLVED, and required for moving to RESOLVED unless the ticket already has one, which it replaces; null is refused and a blank one counts as absent

status.description: IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER or RESOLVED from an open status other than itself, IN_PROGRESS from RESOLVED; nothing returns to NEW and CLOSED only through close

teamId.description: null clears the team and the assignee; a new team without an assigneeId clears the assignee

title.description: 1 to 200 characters after trimming; sent alone or with description, never with the other fields; null is refused
